page_vs_sheet.interpretation: Descriptive retained-position dispersion difference, not a confidence interval or a formal significance test; broad position variation need not imply an order reversal.
Descriptive retained-position dispersion difference, not a confidence interval or a formal significance test; broad position variation need not imply an order reversal.

interpretation.arrivals: 800 candidates per setting deliberately balance eight enriched starts; 100 independent masks are shared across starts.
interpretation.winners: 100 per-mask best-recovered candidates, comparing only identical masks and lambda; finite search, not global optimality or history probability.
interpretation.gaps: Positive100*(E_after-E_before)/min(E_after,E_before) favors first-listed group; missing directions are search-limited.
interpretation.sampling: Native point sampling and sheet adaptation differ; all masks use Bernoulli(.9), not exact90% sample sizes.
interpretation.lambda: Enriched starting permutations are selected per cohort and lambda; contrasts between lambdas include differing start sets.
interpretation.3c_coverage: Starts enrich3a/3b by4a/4c directions;3c ordering is only the coverage actually present/recovered in those eight starts, not all120 B permutations.
